## Why it matters

tímarit.is offers digitized newspapers and magazines from Iceland, Greenland, and the Faroe Islands, with search across titles and article text.

It is a key source for North Atlantic media history, public discourse, and comparative regional research across Danish, Faroese, Icelandic, and Greenlandic materials.
